_comment: Pitch tune v3 (2026-06-25). v1 sysid auto-design angle_kp=4.14 -> 1.5 Hz cascade. v2 capped angle_kp=2.0 but kept rate_kp=0.012 and STILL oscillated at ~2.6 Hz — that was the INNER rate loop: pitch K=1381 is 2.45x roll's 563, so rate_kp 0.012 put the pitch inner-loop crossover at 16.6 rad/s (2.64 Hz) vs roll's stable 6.8 (1.08 Hz). v3 caps the crossover (sysid_fit.choose_crossover wc_max=7.0) so pitch is tuned to the SAME inner-loop bandwidth as the proven-stable roll axis: rate_kp 0.00507, angle_kp 1.75. See docs/journal/log-analysis/20260625-231706-pitch-osc/. Re-apply after each boot: tools/sysid/apply_tune.py --file tools/sysid/pitch_tune.json. NOT persisted on the FC. UNTESTED: first hover low/brief, ready to disarm.
airframe: X-quad. M1,M3 CW, M2,M4 CCW. IMU aligned. Inverted spin vs firmware default (yaw-sign fix).

motor_geometry._comment: Inverted spin vs firmware default -> flips s_mix_yaw only (default spin-sign was backwards -> yaw positive feedback). Roll/pitch mix unchanged. REQUIRED.

rate_pid._comment: controller=1 (rate). pitch crossover capped to roll's proven 1.1 Hz (was 0.012 -> 2.64 Hz inner-loop oscillation).

angle_pid._comment: controller=0 (angle). pitch = 0.25*wc with the capped wc=7.0 -> 1.75, matching roll's proven 1.69.
